classification: bounded CPU-only 90-digit independent material-point replay of exact native555 center and four captured F endpoints; no native transactions or qualification

inputs.parameter_words: exact float32 parameter words from capture header widened to float64 then exact Decimal.from_float
inputs.F_words: captured high+low material-local deformation gradient decoded by prior native555 replay; each widened value converted exactly to Decimal
inputs.old_history: accepted 15-state history from capture, exact float32 words widened to float64

allrow_context.note: All-row statement is from the existing source-bound FP64 sweep. The new 90-digit MP replay is only the five selected material rows below.

constitutive_transition_semantics.hard_max_history: No max-history operator or clipping is present in the 15-state reference residual/update; accepted history is held fixed and history variables 13/14 advance by smooth weighted increments.
constitutive_transition_semantics.positive_stress_weight: Uses smooth sqrt(sigma_i^2+width^2) positive-stress weights, width p[23]; zero is a smoothing center, not a hard branch.
constitutive_transition_semantics.fischer_burmeister: Regularized by positive fb_epsilon p[26]; rationalized residual representation switches only at denominator 1e-14 to a mathematically equivalent direct form. Lambda/yield signs are proximity indicators, not nonsmooth active-set conditions.

limitations: Only five stress points, each center plus four exact captured endpoints, are recomputed at 90-digit Decimal.
Secant distances from positive lambda/yield margins are not root-distance proofs; sampled signs are direct evidence only at endpoints and the stored ideal epsilon grid.
No native FP32 absolute noise floor or global assembly accuracy is established.
This does not alter any strict FP64/FP32 gate or qualify the coupon.
